158:     Parameters
159:     ----------
160:     frequencies : list of np.ndarray
161:         Original frequency values
162:     ref_frequency : float
163:         reference frequency in Hz.
164: 
165:     Returns
166:     -------
167:     frequencies_midi : list of np.ndarray
168:         Continuous MIDI frequency values.
169:     """
170:     return [69.0 + 12.0 * np.log2(freqs / ref_frequency) for freqs in frequencies]
171: 
172: 
173: def midi_to_chroma(frequencies_midi):
174:     """Wrap MIDI frequencies to a single octave (chroma).
175: 
176:     Parameters
177:     ----------
178:     frequencies_midi : list of np.ndarray
179:         Continuous MIDI note frequency values.
180: 
181:     Returns
182:     -------
183:     frequencies_chroma : list of np.ndarray
184:         Midi values wrapped to one octave.
185: 
186:     """
187:     return [np.mod(freqs, 12) for freqs in frequencies_midi]
188: 
189: 
190: def compute_num_freqs(frequencies):
191:     """Compute the number of frequencies for each time point.
192: 
193:     Parameters
194:     ----------
195:     frequencies : list of np.ndarray
196:         Frequency values
197: 
198:     Returns
199:     -------
200:     num_freqs : np.ndarray
201:         Number of frequencies at each time point.
202:     """
203:     return np.array([f.size for f in frequencies])
204: 
205: 
206: def compute_num_true_positives(ref_freqs, est_freqs, window=0.5, chroma=False):
207:     """Compute the number of true positives in an estimate given a reference.
208:     A frequency is correct if it is within a quartertone of the
209:     correct frequency.
210: 
211:     Parameters
212:     ----------
213:     ref_freqs : list of np.ndarray
214:         reference frequencies (MIDI)
215:     est_freqs : list of np.ndarray
216:         estimated frequencies (MIDI)
217:     window : float
218:         Window size, in semitones
219:     chroma : bool
220:         If True, computes distances modulo n.
221:         If True, ``ref_freqs`` and ``est_freqs`` should be wrapped modulo n.
222: 
223:     Returns
224:     -------
225:     true_positives : np.ndarray
226:         Array the same length as ref_freqs containing the number of true
227:         positives.
228: 
229:     """
230:     n_frames = len(ref_freqs)
231:     true_positives = np.zeros((n_frames,))
232: 
233:     for i, (ref_frame, est_frame) in enumerate(zip(ref_freqs, est_freqs)):
234:         if chroma:
235:             # match chroma-wrapped frequency events
236:             matching = util.match_events(
237:                 ref_frame, est_frame, window, distance=util._outer_distance_mod_n
238:             )
239:         else:
240:             # match frequency events within tolerance window in semitones
241:             matching = util.match_events(ref_frame, est_frame, window)
242: 
243:         true_positives[i] = len(matching)
244: 
245:     return true_positives
246: 
247: 
248: def compute_accuracy(true_positives, n_ref, n_est):
249:     """Compute accuracy metrics.
250: 
251:     Parameters
252:     ----------
253:     true_positives : np.ndarray
254:         Array containing the number of true positives at each time point.
255:     n_ref : np.ndarray
256:         Array containing the number of reference frequencies at each time
257:         point.
258:     n_est : np.ndarray
259:         Array containing the number of estimate frequencies at each time point.
260: 
261:     Returns
262:     -------
263:     precision : float
264:         ``sum(true_positives)/sum(n_est)``
265:     recall : float
266:         ``sum(true_positives)/sum(n_ref)``
267:     acc : float
268:         ``sum(true_positives)/sum(n_est + n_ref - true_positives)``
269: 
270:     """
271:     true_positive_sum = float(true_positives.sum())
272: 
273:     n_est_sum = n_est.sum()
274:     if n_est_sum > 0:
275:         precision = true_positive_sum / n_est.sum()
276:     else:
277:         warnings.warn("Estimate frequencies are all empty.")
278:         precision = 0.0
279: 
280:     n_ref_sum = n_ref.sum()
281:     if n_ref_sum > 0:
282:         recall = true_positive_sum / n_ref.sum()
283:     else:
284:         warnings.warn("Reference frequencies are all empty.")
285:         recall = 0.0
286: 
287:     acc_denom = (n_est + n_ref - true_positives).sum()
288:     if acc_denom > 0:
289:         acc = true_positive_sum / acc_denom
290:     else:
291:         acc = 0.0
292: 
293:     return precision, recall, acc
294: 
295: 
296: def compute_err_score(true_positives, n_ref, n_est):
297:     """Compute error score metrics.
298: 
299:     Parameters
300:     ----------
301:     true_positives : np.ndarray
302:         Array containing the number of true positives at each time point.
303:     n_ref : np.ndarray
304:         Array containing the number of reference frequencies at each time
305:         point.
306:     n_est : np.ndarray
307:         Array containing the number of estimate frequencies at each time point.
308: 
309:     Returns
310:     -------
311:     e_sub : float
312:         Substitution error
313:     e_miss : float
